title: First-Order In-Context Shapley: Scalable Data Auditing for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2607.22766v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training alignment of Large Language Models is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality: preference and instruction-tuning corpora accumulate label noise, safety inversions, and inter-annotator contradictions that deduplication misses and full-corpus LLM judging cannot afford. While Data Shapley offers a principled valuation framework, exact computation requires intractable retraining, and embedding surrogates like KNN-Shapley fail to separate high- from low-utility demonstrations ($\rho = 0.0003$ with generative utility). We introduce an inference-only valuation pipeline that computes the first-order term of an in-context cooperative game over semantic $k$-NN neighborhoods in $O(k)$ forward passes without parameter updates, correlating positively with multi-shot Monte-Carlo in-context Shapley on 100% of targets at 19x less compute. translated_title: 一阶上下文内沙普利：面向大语言模型对齐与评估的可扩展数据审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的后训练对齐正日益受到数据质量的制约：偏好数据与指令微调语料库中不断累积标签噪声、安全反转以及标注者之间的矛盾，而去重方法无法发现这些问题，全语料库的大模型评审又成本高昂难以负担。虽然 Data Shapley 提供了一个有原则性的数据估值框架，但精确计算需要进行难以承受的重训练，而诸如 KNN-Shapley 之类的嵌入代理方法则无法区分高效用与低效用的演示样本（与生成式效用的相关性仅为 ρ = 0.0003）。我们提出了一种仅基于推理的估值流水线，它在语义 k 近邻邻域上计算上下文内合作博弈的一阶项，仅需 O(k) 次前向传播且无需任何参数更新；该估值在 100% 的目标样本上与多次采样蒙特卡洛上下文内 Shapley 呈正相关，同时计算量减少 19 倍。通过将成对对数似然变化投影到有向影响图上，可以刻画每个……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种仅需推理、无需重训练的一阶上下文内 Shapley 数据估值方法，可在 O(k) 次前向传播内完成对大语言模型对齐数据的可扩展审计，以 19 倍更少的计算量实现了与蒙特卡洛上下文内 Shapley 在全部目标样本上一致的估值效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a first-order in-context Shapley valuation pipeline that audits LLM alignment data via inference only—computing valuations in O(k) forward passes without retraining—achieving positive correlation with multi-shot Monte-Carlo in-context Shapley on 100% of targets at 19x less compute.
